subject: Quick question
body: Is the Madurai District Central Library open on Sundays, and is it closed for Diwali week? Thanks

subject: Saturday working at Adyar branch
body:
Dear Sir/Madam,
Could you please tell me whether your Adyar branch works on the second and fourth Saturdays? My father is a pensioner and prefers to visit on weekends when I can accompany him. Please also let me know if there is a lunch break during which the counters close.
Regards,
Karthik Raman

subject: Re: Opening hours over Christmas
body:
Hello,
We are visiting Chennai from Toronto between 24 and 28 December. Is the Government Museum open on Christmas Day and the day after? Your website and a travel blog show different hours, so I wanted to confirm directly.
Cheers,
Daniel Whitmore

subject: outpatient timing
body: hi, what time does the OPD open on sundays? my mother need to see a skin doctor and im not sure if its open or only emergency is there. also is there a lunch break for doctors

subject: Where is your city ticket office?
body: Where exactly is your Bengaluru city office located? Google Maps shows two different addresses. - Rohan

subject: Open day on 7 November - route and parking
body:
Dear Admissions Office,
I will be attending the open day on 7 November with my daughter and we are driving from Coimbatore. Could you share the best route from the highway and tell us where visitors are supposed to park? Is there any landmark near the main gate that we can look for? We are a little worried about arriving late because we do not know the area.
We would also like to know if there is a separate entrance for open day visitors. Any help with the directions would be appreciated.
Thank you,
Suresh Iyer

subject: Visiting your Pune centre as a volunteer
body:
Hi there,
I came across your NGO on Instagram and would like to visit your children's learning centre in Pune this Saturday to see how things work before I think about volunteering. I will be coming from Pune railway station. What is the easiest way to reach you, by auto, bus or metro? Is there a landmark nearby, as the map pin looks a bit off? Can I just walk in, or do visitors need to inform someone first, and if so who should I ask for? Also, what time does the centre usually close on Saturdays?
Thanks a lot,
Priya Deshmukh

subject: location?
body: do you have a branch in hyderabad, hitech city side? saw your bangalore one on instagram but cant find anything for hyd. and whats the nearest metro if there is one

subject: Visiting rules for the general ward
body:
Good afternoon,
My uncle is likely to be admitted to your hospital next week for a planned knee surgery, and the family would like to understand the visiting rules in advance. What are the visiting hours for the general ward and for the private rooms? Are children under 12 allowed to visit, or is there an age restriction? How many visitors can be with the patient at one time? Is one attendant allowed to stay overnight, and is there any ID or visitor pass system at the entrance? We want to plan so that relatives travelling from other towns are not turned away at the gate.
Thank you,
Anitha Subramanian

subject: Data privacy question
body: Does the university share the alumni database with third parties? Where can I read the full privacy policy? Regards, Lukas Berger

subject: Accessibility services
body:
Hi,
I am a research student with low vision. Does your library offer screen readers, large-print material or any other assistive technology? Do I need to register separately to use them? Thank you for your time.
Nisha Menon

subject: Photography allowed?
body: can i bring a camera and tripod inside? its for a college photo assignment

subject: Sponsorship opportunities for Techvista 2027
body:
Dear Sir/Madam,
I am the sponsorship coordinator for Techvista, an inter-college technical festival at SRM Institute that expects around 3000 participants on 12-13 February. We would like to know whether your bank has a CSR or sponsorship programme for student events. If yes, could you tell us whom to send the proposal to?
Warm regards,
Aishwarya Nair

subject: Collaboration with your literacy programme
body:
Hello,
I run a small community library in Kozhikode and we would love to explore working with your foundation on book donations for rural schools. Does your NGO partner with small local groups, and is there a form or a contact person for this? Any guidance would be welcome.
Best,
Abdul Rahim

subject: Supplier registration enquiry
body:
Good afternoon, I hope this email finds you well.
We are a small company in Coimbatore that makes reusable surgical linen and we would like to understand how your hospital works with outside suppliers before preparing any proposal. How does vendor registration work, and is there a particular procurement officer we should address? Are there documents such as GST certificates or quality certifications that you require at the first stage? Do you accept introductions by email or only through a registered portal? We would also like to know how often your purchase committee reviews new suppliers. We are not submitting any quotation at this point, only trying to understand the process.
Kind regards,
Mohan Prakash
Director, Sri Textile Care

subject: Corporate tie-up
body: Does your airline offer tie-ups with travel agencies for group travel? Who should I speak to? Regards, Imran Sheikh

subject: Suggestion for the website
body:
Hi team,
Just a suggestion: it would be really helpful if the website had a Tamil language option for senior citizens. This is not a complaint at all, I find the service good. Could you tell me where such suggestions can be sent so the right team sees them?
Thanks,
Lakshmi Narayanan

subject: idea for kids
body: loved the dinosaur gallery! maybe a weekend storytelling session for children would be nice? who can i pass this to

subject: Re: Study spaces in exam season
body:
Hello,
I use the reading hall almost every day and feel that extending the closing time during exam weeks would help a lot of students. Is there a feedback form or a student committee where this kind of idea can be proposed? I am not complaining, just wondering how to share it properly.
Thank you,
Farhan Ali

subject: Feedback after trying a day visit
body:
Hey,
We stopped by your Whitefield space last week as guests of a friend and liked the atmosphere. A small suggestion would be to add a quiet pod for phone calls. Who should I send this to, and do you run any member surveys where ideas like this are collected?
Cheers,
Tom Hendricks

subject: RTI procedure - how it works
body:
Dear Sir,
I would like to understand how an RTI application is filed with your department, what the fee is and how long a reply normally takes. I have not filed anything yet and only want to know the procedure.
Regards,
S. Venkatesan

subject: How do your preventive health check-ups work?
body:
Hello,
My parents are in their sixties and I have been reading about master health check-ups, so I wanted to ask how your programme works in general. Is an appointment needed, or can people walk in? Roughly how long does the whole check-up take, and do patients have to fast beforehand? Are the reports given the same day or sent later? I would also like to know whether there are different packages for different age groups and what the approximate price range is. I am only collecting information right now and have not decided anything.
Thanks,
Meenakshi Sundaram

subject: credit transfer
body: How does credit transfer work for exchange students visiting from abroad? Is there a page explaining it? Regards, Elena Rossi

subject: Re: Unaccompanied minor service
body:
Hello,
My sister's 11-year-old son will be travelling from Delhi to Kolkata in December. Can you explain how the unaccompanied minor service works and from what age it is applicable? I am only gathering information at the moment.
Thank you,
Kavita Joshi

subject: Information needed
body: Which department handles research collaboration with industry? Please share an email or phone number. Thanks, Dr. Hannah Fischer

subject: right office?
body: hello, i want to know which office handles trade licence renewal for small shops in ward 12. should i go to the zonal office or the main corporation building? and is there any helpline number

subject: Senior citizens' desk contact
body:
Good morning,
Is there a dedicated phone number or email for the senior citizens' desk at your regional office in Nagpur? My grandmother finds the general helpline confusing.
Thank you,
Rahul Kulkarni

subject: Who to contact about community events?
body:
Hi,
I work as a community manager at a startup in Chennai, and several of us are interested in attending events at your co-working space. Is there a particular person or department that handles community events? Is there a monthly calendar published anywhere, and are the events open to people who are not members? Also, do you collaborate with outside groups to host meetups, and if so, where should an enquiry like that go? A phone number would help as well, since I could not find one on the site.
Thanks very much,
Vikram Seshadri

subject: Press query: oncology wing inauguration
body:
Hello,
I am a reporter with the city desk at a daily newspaper and need to file a story for tomorrow's edition. Could you confirm the date and time of the inauguration of the new oncology wing, and whether media passes are required? Please also share the name of your press contact. A reply before 3 pm today would be really helpful.
Regards,
Divya Raghavan

subject: Heritage walk
body: is the heritage walk on 1 november open to the public or only members? thanks!

subject: Can outside organisations use the auditorium?
body:
Dear Sir/Madam,
We are planning a one-day science seminar for around 150 people in January and are looking at different venues. Does the university lend its auditorium to outside organisations, and if so, how does one begin an enquiry? We are in the very early stages and have not fixed anything yet. It would also help to know which department deals with these requests. Is there a minimum notice period that is usually expected? We would also like to know whether there are any restrictions on the type of events, for example on events with ticketed entry.
Thank you,
Gurpreet Kaur

subject: Tree plantation drive on 14 November
body:
Hello,
I saw a post that your NGO is organising a tree plantation drive on 14 November. Could you tell me the time and venue, and whether volunteers need to register beforehand? Our college NSS group may attend.
Thanks,
Ananya Bhattacharya

subject: Eligibility for MSc Data Science
body:
Hello,
I am completing my BCA this year with around 68 percent. Could you confirm whether BCA graduates are eligible for the MSc Data Science programme, and which documents are needed when applying? Thank you.
Arjun Mehta

body:
Hi,
I am an Indian student studying in Germany and my parents suggested I should have an account back home. I am not applying yet, but could you tell me what documents are generally required for someone in my situation and whether it can be done without visiting the branch? Thank you for your help.
Sneha Pillai

subject: Library membership for non-residents
body:
Dear Librarian,
I live just outside the city limits. Can non-residents become members of the public library, and what ID proof is required? Is there an age limit for the children's section?
Thank you,
Mrs. D'Souza

subject: Wheelchair access?
body: Does the museum have ramps or lifts for wheelchair access to all floors? Visiting with my father this Sunday. - Ramesh

body: hi, is there parking for visitors at your hospital and is it free? we will be coming from far in a big car for a family checkup and dont know if there is space on weekdays

subject: Wi-Fi and facilities at your space
body:
Hello,
I am a freelance designer relocating to Pune and I am looking at a few co-working options. Could you tell me what the internet speeds are like, whether there are phone booths for calls, and if there is a cafeteria on site? I have not made any decision yet and just want to understand what is available.
Thanks,
Chloe Bernard

subject: Airport facilities for travelling with a baby
body:
Hi,
I am flying with your airline from Chennai to Singapore on 29 October with my 18-month-old daughter. Could you tell me what facilities are available at the airport for families, such as a baby-care room or a place to warm milk? Is Wi-Fi free at the terminal, and is there any limit on the time? Does your airline have a lounge, and if so, are children allowed in it? Also, is there a place to store a stroller before boarding, or does it have to go to the gate? Lastly, is there a prayer room somewhere in the departure area?
Thanks in advance,
Shalini Rajan
